checks.description: Verify approved design_name=ddr4_controller_top and requested package design_type=memory_controller against preserved request/provenance; do not compare them with module design_name/design_type.
Compare all exact ports/directions/widths and contract references with the approved architecture; confirm host_protocol role and no owned state; enforce public interface and ownership boundaries.
Check txn_ready=rst_n&&queue_ready and enq_valid=rst_n&&txn_valid for all input combinations; qualifying edges are independent of response traffic.
assumptions: queue_ready is driven by the queue environment; queue occupancy and dispatch semantics are not proven by this adapter check.
Host holds transaction payload stable when presenting a stalled valid request.

checks.description: Compare all packed payload field offsets and values against independently driven bank/row/column/write/data values, including boundary values; no state or capture latency is introduced here.
assumptions: The queue, not the adapter, captures admitted payloads and preserves them while blocked.

checks.description: Check rsp_valid=rst_n&&rsp_valid_in and rsp_rdata=rst_n?rsp_data:0, including rsp_valid_in low; do not infer READ latency/retention from a stateless forwarding stage.
assumptions: Response inputs represent the independently registered memory response; its generation, hold behavior and one-cycle READ latency require separate memory/system checks.

checks.description: Toggle transaction, queue and response inputs throughout asserted reset; require txn_ready/enq_valid/rsp_valid=0 and rsp_rdata=0. Check release and reset coincident with offered transaction/response.
assumptions: No internal waiting, active, memory, refresh or timing state exists in this module.

checks.description: Check admission and response forwarding independently and simultaneously, including reset suppression; outputs follow the declared combinational inputs without extra clocked state or event updates.
assumptions: System request/response accounting is deferred; this test verifies only independent local interface behavior.
